Full summary: Reviewed 591fcf63 (repo_ids readers + migrate id reuse): no blocker/major. Pre-fix RED and post-fix GREEN reproduced; both-keys stores unchanged except rerun migrated_from now stable; shared-store fallback matches every producer.
Findings: Review 591fcf63 verified by running the new suites against the PARENT source (git checkout HEAD~1 -- the two src files): retrieval 3 failed/5 passed, migrate 4 failed/0 passed with the exact assertions the implementer reported; fixed source 8/8 and 4/4; v3-forward 35/35, v3-rollback 19/19, migrate/cli 14+1 skipped, context-assembler 47/47; tsc exit 0 run last.; Confirmed empirically (old-code migrate then new-code rerun on the same store): a store migrated PRE-fix after identity init is NOT healed — legacy/migration-state.json identity wins and the identity-init ids are absent from store.json entirely (not even in repo_ids). Detector for the trial arm: distinct scope.repo values across events/ vs store.json repo_id; a state identity store_id without the ULID timestamp prefix (s_01M…) is path-seeded.; warning: readers now disagree on one hand-written shape only — declaredRepoId (retrieval + migrate) takes repo_id first, repoIdFor (adapter runtime) takes repo_ids[0]; they coincide on every producer-written file because finalize writes identity.repo_id first and ensureStoreDescriptor only appends. test/retrieval/store-identity.test.ts 'prefers repo_id over repo_ids[0]' pins the divergent shape {repo_id:A, repo_ids:[B,A]} as desired; the store-identity.ts header claims agreement with repoIdFor only for the repo_id-absent case.; Committed suites never mint a runtime event (openRuntime/append); the 'every event already cites repo_ids[0]' claim is pinned via migrated events + readStoreDescriptor only. An untracked probe left in worktree wf_7fdd8f5c-571-2 (test/migrate/zz-probe-e2e.test.ts) does init -> runtime append -> migrate and passes (46 events, one scope.repo) — worth promoting into v3-identity-reuse.test.ts.
